window_basis: Original disclosure/report date, not event occurrence or feed update

newsletter.subject: The Security Diff — November 15, 2026
newsletter.preview_text: CI credentials, trusted releases and forgotten cloud access: three incidents, three patch briefings and one agent-security research note.

notes: The same Aikido capture gives 1,835 executions in its opening bullets and 1,806 later. Neither count is used in the email. Repository probes are not equivalent to executed payloads.
Do not merge this campaign into the previously published October GhostAction identity without evidence.
One event covers both release artifacts; keep both original research reports and the package advisory.
A safe earlier version or replacement app does not clean persistence. Do not describe the malware advisory as having a patched version; it lists none.
Supplement discovered through the Wiz Apache page, absent from the rolling issue and retained article leads.
The two reports describe a joint investigation, not independent corroboration. Avoid generalizing Sentra’s headline to every Qubole customer.
The monitored article-host allowlist lacks sentra.io; do not alter collector configuration in this editorial packet.
Group Aikido and Wiz as one vulnerability story. Apache is authoritative for its affected range and release.

Wiz’s standalone mod_h2 table includes 2.0.42 as patched, but its prose says newer than 2.0.42; Apache says 2.0.42 is affected. Do not repeat the contradictory table or infer a standalone fixed version.
No current EPSS, KEV or confirmed exploitation assertion is made. The article-host allowlist lacks httpd.apache.org.
MongoDB said it was not aware of exploitation attempts at its November 10 announcement; this is a dated statement, not proof of absence.

The MongoDB-issued CNA record was separately checked: 8.0.0 <= affected < 8.0.37, alongside the other six branch ranges. The GHSA page itself shows unknown package ranges, so do not use it as the source of fixed versions.
Vendor forum and CNA hosts are not in the incident article-host allowlist.
One release roundup, not one incident per CVE. Keep the October Node2Shell story separate.
No demonstrated compromise, current exploitation, KEV or EPSS claim is added.
Keep controlled research separate from incident reports. The incident publisher does not provide a general research publication lane.
